versions.changelog:
- Updated installation instructions in SKILL.md to list pip install first for improved clarity.
- Streamlined install section by reorganizing and reordering script and platform-specific commands.
- Removed references and instructions that prioritized one-line install scripts over pip.
- skill-card.md file has been removed.

- Added pip-based installation method for aitun (cross-platform, bundles the binary).
- Updated metadata to support installation via both pip and uv.
- Refreshed instructions to include pip install instructions.
- Updated CLI reference to mention all supported installation methods.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

- Added installation instructions for Windows (PowerShell) in the setup section.
- No other documentation or functional changes.

- Updated to version 1.0.3.
- SKILL.md: Improved installation instructions—now suggests verifying aitun install with just `which aitun` (removed `pip show aitun`).
- No changes to functionality or API. Documentation clarification only.

- Updated installation instructions to use the official shell script (`curl -fsSL https://aitun.cc/install.sh | bash`) instead of `pip install aitun`.
- Updated CLI reference section to reflect new installation method.
- No other functional or usage changes.

- Added version field to SKILL.md and set to 1.0.1.
- Clarified CLI reference: clarified that `-p PORT` is optional and can be omitted for TCP-only mode, and that `--tcp-ports` can be used without `-p`.
- Removed the file `skill-card.md`.
Initial release - expose local API for external testing via aitun tunnel
